ai.body: Type the way you think. Suku creates the task, moves the meeting, sets the reminder and remembers what you told it last week.

ai.briefingBody: Three things matter today: the client deck is due at 14:00, your reading habit is on a 9-day streak, and Thursday is still free for your weekly planning.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Suku is a personal app for running your day. Tasks, projects, calendar, habits, gym workouts and whiteboards live in one place, and Suku AI helps you keep track of all of it.
faq.a2: Yes. “Try the demo” opens the Suku app at suku.ink, where the demo account lets you click around with sample tasks, projects and habits. There’s no sign-up. Demo data resets when you refresh.
faq.q3: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a3: Yes. Suku is an installable web app. Open it in your phone's browser and add it to your home screen, and it behaves like a native app, including notifications.
faq.q4: Does it sync with Google Calendar?
faq.a4: Yes. Connect your Google account in Suku and your events appear in the calendar and on your dashboard next to your tasks.
faq.a5: You can ask it in plain language to create or update tasks, projects and calendar events, set reminders, or check on your habits and gym records. It also writes your Daily Briefing each morning.
faq.a6: Yes. The whole app, including this page, is available in English and German. Switch any time with the EN/DE toggle.
